page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge is a general-purpose server instance utilizing the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, providing 24 dedicated physical cores with one thread per core. The hardware configuration includes 96 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. This instance does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage for data persistence, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core processing is weak, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression categorized as poor. Conversely, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU benchmarks. Memory bandwidth for both read and write operations, as well as Redis database operations, also perform within the average tier.

From a resource density perspective, the instance offers a balanced allocation of compute and memory resources. The dedicated CPU cores ensure consistent multi-threaded execution without resource contention, though the older processor architecture limits single-threaded efficiency. This profile is appropriate for multi-threaded workloads, static web serving, and database operations that benefit from parallel processing and do not require high-speed local storage.
